name: RAZA MD Pair and Deploy
description: Pairing site and one-tap Heroku deployer for RAZA MD.

HEROKU_API_KEY.description: Heroku API key that owns the bot apps.

PAIR_SERVER_URL.description: This site's public URL. Each bot fetches its session from it.

PREFIX.description: Command prefix passed to each bot.

DB_HOST.description: Database host passed to each bot.

DB_PORT.description: Database port passed to each bot.

DB_NAME.description: Database name passed to each bot.

DB_USER.description: Database user passed to each bot.

DB_PASSWORD.description: Database password passed to each bot.
